line.en: the traditional stall market on petersplatz, open until 10 november. go at midday, before the crowds of the afternoon.
line.de: der traditionelle standmarkt auf dem petersplatz, bis 10. november geöffnet. am mittag hingehen, vor dem nachmittagsandrang.
line.tr: petersplatz'ta geleneksel tezgâh pazarı, 10 kasım'a kadar açık. öğlen gidin, öğleden sonraki kalabalıktan önce.

sparks.why: Hääfelimäärt on Petersplatz, open until 10 Nov 2026, listed with the Basler Herbstmesse (bs.ch and nume.ch search summaries). Monday 2 Nov is not a holiday in Basel-Stadt.
